proof_body:
by
  intro V P _ _ _ _ s A B X h hXA hXB
  have hA : dist A s.center = s.radius := h.left_mem
  have hr : 0 ≤ s.radius := hA ▸ dist_nonneg
  have hc : s.center = midpoint ℝ A B := h.midpoint_eq_center.symm
  have hopp : B -ᵥ s.center = -(A -ᵥ s.center) := by
    rw [hc, left_vsub_midpoint, right_vsub_midpoint, ← smul_neg, neg_vsub_eq_vsub_rev]
  have hnA : ‖A -ᵥ s.center‖ = s.radius := by rw [← dist_eq_norm_vsub V, hA]
  have hd : dist X s.center = ‖X -ᵥ s.center‖ := dist_eq_norm_vsub V _ _
  have hin : inner ℝ (A -ᵥ X) (B -ᵥ X) = dist X s.center ^ 2 - s.radius ^ 2 := by
    rw [← vsub_sub_vsub_cancel_right A X s.center, ← vsub_sub_vsub_cancel_right B X s.center, hopp, hd, ← hnA]
    simp only [inner_sub_left, inner_sub_right, inner_neg_left, inner_neg_right, real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq]
    rw [real_inner_comm (A -ᵥ s.center) (X -ᵥ s.center)]
    ring
  have hk : 0 < ‖A -ᵥ X‖ * ‖B -ᵥ X‖ := mul_pos (norm_pos_iff.mpr (vsub_ne_zero.mpr hXA.symm)) (norm_pos_iff.mpr (vsub_ne_zero.mpr hXB.symm))
  have hcos : Real.cos (EuclideanGeometry.angle A X B) * (‖A -ᵥ X‖ * ‖B -ᵥ X‖) = dist X s.center ^ 2 - s.radius ^ 2 := by
    rw [← hin]; exact InnerProductGeometry.cos_angle_mul_norm_mul_norm _ _
  have h0 := EuclideanGeometry.angle_nonneg A X B
  have h1 := EuclideanGeometry.angle_le_pi A X B
  have hdn : 0 ≤ dist X s.center := dist_nonneg
  have hpi := Real.pi_pos
  rcases lt_trichotomy (EuclideanGeometry.angle A X B) (Real.pi / 2) with hlt | heq | hgt
  · have hc' : 0 < Real.cos (EuclideanGeometry.angle A X B) := Real.cos_pos_of_mem_Ioo ⟨by linarith, hlt⟩
    have : s.radius < dist X s.center := by
      have := mul_pos hc' hk
      nlinarith
    exact ⟨⟨fun h' => by linarith, fun h' => by linarith⟩, ⟨fun _ => this, fun _ => hlt⟩⟩
  · rw [heq, Real.cos_pi_div_two, zero_mul] at hcos
    have : dist X s.center = s.radius := by nlinarith
    rw [heq, this]
    simp
  · have hc' : Real.cos (EuclideanGeometry.angle A X B) < 0 := Real.cos_neg_of_pi_div_two_lt_of_lt hgt (by linarith)
    have : dist X s.center < s.radius := by
      have := mul_neg_of_neg_of_pos hc' hk
      nlinarith
    exact ⟨⟨fun _ => this, fun _ => hgt⟩, ⟨fun h' => by linarith, fun h' => by linarith⟩⟩
target_source: ∀ (V P : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] (s : EuclideanGeometry.Sphere P) (A B X : P), s.IsDiameter A B → X ≠ A → X ≠ B → (Real.pi / 2 < EuclideanGeometry.angle A X B ↔ dist X s.center < s.radius) ∧ (EuclideanGeometry.angle A X B < Real.pi / 2 ↔ s.radius < dist X s.center)
